changes.title: MOTI MAHAL
changes.detail: Description changed (see changes.json for full before/after)
changes.before:
Top: Organza
Bottom: Bamber Silk
Dupatta: Organza

Moti Mahal is an ethereal seven-panel organza kurta that captures the grace of a bygone era. Each panel is beautifully embroidered with tilla, resham, and sequins, while softly scalloped edges and tassel details add a delicate, romantic finish.

It is paired with a classic churidar pajama and a checkered organza dupatta finished with embroidery, completing a look that is timeless, airy, and effortlessly elegant for every formal occasion.
